t_advice_summary_textbox.text: each gnome appears in a specific pairing. The amount of mushrooms can vary with the most being 9 mushrooms. There is always a gnome which gives more mushrooms and this can be figured out.

vb_textbox.text: Use the first sets of pairs as an experiment to determine which side gives the higher reward and try to remember the colour. Rewards of 5 and below can be deemed the "low" side. After every break, use the first pairs as experiments to find your colours. There are 4 sets of pairs - green/blue, fushia/yellow, orange/purple, brown/pink. Try not to get frustrated if you get a few zeros! Use them to work out when things have changed sides! The hats mean nothing. You can do this!
